title: Geeta Durham Joins Korn Ferry Senior Client Partner
summary: Geeta Durham has joined Korn Ferry as North America Lead for Strategy and Change within the firm’s Talent and Organizational Solutions business.
body_markdown:
**San Francisco, September 22, 2026** – Korn Ferry (NYSE: KFY) today announced that Geeta Durham has joined the firm as North America Lead for Strategy and Change within the firm’s Talent and Organizational Solutions business. She will be based in the firm's San Francisco office.


Durham brings more than two decades of experience advising executive teams on business and organizational change. She helps organizations manage M&A, operating model shifts, growth strategies, leadership transitions, culture change, and AI-enabled transformation.


“Geeta is a seasoned consultant and trusted advisor who brings extensive experience helping organizations align leadership, talent and culture with business strategy,” said Yaarit Silverstone, President of North America Consulting, Korn Ferry. “Her expertise will help us continue supporting clients as they navigate complex transitions and transform their organizations.


Durham holds a master’s degree in science from George Mason University. She also has certifications in Change, Coaching, and Organization Design.


**About Korn Ferry**


Korn Ferry is a global consulting firm that powers performance. We unlock the potential in your people and unleash transformation across your business—synchronizing strategy, operations, and talent to accelerate performance, fuel growth, and inspire a legacy of change. That’s why the world’s most forward-thinking companies across every major industry turn to us—for a shared commitment to lasting impact and the bold ambition to *Be More Than* .


As the Official Talent & Organizational Consulting Partner of LA28, Korn Ferry is powering the nearly 5,000 people who power the Olympic Games—bringing in the right talent, building strong leaders, and shaping the structure and culture that will deliver an unforgettable experience for the world.
